summary: ITERATION 2: Completed comprehensive testing of Fabrika Management System. Backend APIs are fully functional (24/24 tests passed). Frontend functionality works for admin users created via backend, but frontend registration flow has critical issues preventing admin user creation. HTML table structure violations persist despite claimed fixes.

ui_bugs.issue: HTML structure violations persist - div elements incorrectly nested within table elements (thead, tbody, tr, th, td)
ui_bugs.impact: Causes React hydration errors and console warnings, but does not prevent functionality

integration_issues.issue: Users registered via frontend always get 'viewer' role, even when backend logic should create admin users
integration_issues.impact: Admin functionality not accessible through normal registration flow

integration_issues.issue: Dialog overlays sometimes block navigation clicks, requiring force clicks
integration_issues.impact: Minor UX issue with modal interactions

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix frontend user registration flow. Users registered through the frontend UI always receive 'viewer' role instead of 'admin' role, even when backend logic should assign admin role to first user or users without existing admins. Backend-created admin users work perfectly and have full functionality. The HTML table structure issues from iteration 1 persist despite claimed fixes - div elements are still nested within table elements causing React hydration errors.
